verdict.rationale: EFTPS supports scheduled payments, a basic form of automation, so asking whether those automations can be versioned, reviewed, and rolled back is a fair question for this product. The evidence only shows that scheduled payments can be changed or cancelled and that payment history can be viewed. Neither amounts to version history, review, or rollback of an automation's definition, so this is adjacent support only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
